summary: Bounded Files organization and explicit Puppy stopping.

improvements: Files organization instructions use bounded exploration and the declared completion contract.
fixes: Puppy Cancel stops the exact admitted turn even when an HTTP edge retains its stream.
Cancellation during cold admission and failed device-stop delivery have bounded, visible outcomes.
security: Stops remain bound to the owner, pod incarnation, originating app, trusted device and request.
No cloud inference fallback or new device grants are introduced.
